recentItems.title: ‘Bakit Hindi Ka Crush ng Crush Mo?’ FULL MOVIE  TEASER |  Kim Chiu, Xian Lim
recentItems.description:
Based on Ramon Bautista’s book of the same name, this film adaptation revolves around Sandy’s (Kim Chiu) quest to find the answer to why she is repeatedly brokenhearted despite giving her all for love. Her boss Alex (Xian Lim) comes to her rescue by helping her improve herself. Is this Sandy’s chance for true love? Released in 2013 and directed by Joyce Bernal. 

Starring Kim Chiu, Xian Lim, Kean Cipriano, Mylene Dizon, and Freddie Webb.
